disclaimer: Domain knowledge, not legal advice. Confirm applicability per jurisdiction with a qualified reviewer.

items.name: Fair Housing Act (US) / anti-discrimination advertising rules
items.scope: Prohibits discrimination in the sale, rental, or advertising of housing based on protected classes (race, color, religion, sex, national origin, familial status, disability).
items.notes: Applies to listing copy, image selection, and tenant screening criteria; other countries have analogous anti-discrimination housing law.

items.name: GDPR — buyer/tenant personal data
items.scope: General data protection obligations for lead, applicant, tenant, and owner personal data.
items.notes: Applies whenever an EU/EEA data subject's data is processed, regardless of operator location.

items.name: Anti-money-laundering obligations for estate/letting agents
items.jurisdiction: United Kingdom, European Union (varies by member state)
items.scope: Estate agency and, in the UK, high-value letting businesses must register as an AML-regulated business, perform customer due diligence, and report suspicious activity.
items.notes: Highly jurisdiction-specific; cited as an illustrative UK/EU example, not a global requirement.

items.name: Tenant deposit protection schemes
items.jurisdiction: Varies (e.g. UK, several US states, other jurisdictions)
items.scope: Requires a landlord/agent to place a tenant's deposit in a government-approved protection scheme within a set period and provide prescribed information.
items.notes: Not universal — many jurisdictions have no equivalent requirement; must be checked per jurisdiction.

items.name: Property condition / seller disclosure requirements
items.version: varies by jurisdiction (e.g. US state seller-disclosure statutes)
items.scope: Requires a seller/landlord to disclose known material defects or hazards (e.g. lead paint, flood risk) before a sale or lease.
items.notes: No single global rule; scope and required forms vary sharply by jurisdiction.
